Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that's all we have from this match. Ireland successfully managed to shock West Indies despite having all the off-field issues related to the Covid-19 cases. This series win will do a world of good to their confidence. For West Indies, it's time to return to the drawing board and rethink their overall game. Their performance is on the decline and a serious brush-up is required. On that note, it's time to bid you farewell. We look forward to your company in future. Cheers!

Paul Stirling, the victorious captain of Ireland, says that they are delighted with this win, especially after going 1-0 down. He is happy that the toss favoured them. Shares that Andy Balbirnie is loving life back in the hotel room and he will be buzzing for the lads. Praises Harry Tector for an amazing series and hopes that he continues to impress. Regarding Andy McBrine, Stirling replies that he has only good words for him and further adds that he epitomizes what an Irish cricket should be!

Kieron Pollard, the captain of West Indies, says that it's a sad day for them and he takes full responsibility as the leader of the team. Tells us that it's a bitter pill to swallow. Feels that they have a batting problem and cannot hide from that. Admits that they have not been up to the standard. Pollard doesn't want to blame his bowlers much as the wicket flattened out in the afternoon. He feels that it's a holistic sort of approach that needs to take place. Opines that throughout the region, they tend to praise mediocrity that's coming out and quickly adds that he might get into trouble for saying that. Further says that the desire for excellence is there in the squad, they train hard and want to get better but it won't happen overnight. Signs off by saying that as a team they need to sit down and think deeply about where they need to take the West Indies cricket.

Andy McBrine is the Player of the Match and Series! The all-rounder says that this victory means a lot as the last few weeks have not been easy for them. Adds that there was a nice bit of spin for him and he enjoyed bowling here. Shares that he struggled for timing with the bat. Talking about his partnership with Harry Tector, Andy McBrine tells that they tried to keep things simple as there was no scoreboard pressure. Praises Harry Tector for having an exceptional series. Andy signs off by saying that he wants to contribute as much as possible to the team.
Presentation time...

West Indies will be deeply disappointed with their efforts - both with the bat and ball. They threw away the advantage after a rollicking start to the match and then with the ball, their bowlers failed to create timely breakthroughs. Alzarri Joseph and Romario Shepherd were decent but never threatened to pick wickets. Akeal Hosein was the best bowler by far once he found his rhythm and picked up three wickets. Roston Chase also bagged a 3-fer and took advantage of the nerves shown by Ireland to close the game. The hosts were once again mediocre with their catching as they offered life to Paul Stirling on zero and also put down Andy McBrine on 28.

Apart from the first 10 overs of this match, Ireland always stayed ahead of the hosts. Their exceptional comeback with the ball forced West Indies on the back foot and they never recovered. The stand between Jason Holder and Akeal Hosein offered them some runs to fight with but despite picking the wicket of William Porterfield with the first ball of the chase, the hosts failed to capitalize. Paul Stirling and Andy McBrine steadied the innings with their strong association and McBrine extended it further along with Harry Tector. With victory in sight, Ireland's inexperience showed up as they slipped from 190/4 to 208/8 but Craig Young maintained a cool head to hit the winning runs.

A bit of hara-kiri towards the end but Ireland eventually crossed the line to create history by taking down West Indies in their own den. A massive moment for the Irish boys who struggled to put out a team of eleven players at one stage but showed character to take the fight to the Windies and earn 20 critical points for the ICC Men's CWC Super League. Courtesy of a 2-1 series win, Ireland have now leapfrogged Australia in the table and they are placed at number 3, below England and Bangladesh.

FOUR! Craig Young has done it! Fractionally short in length, outside off, Young stays on the back foot and opens the face of his bat late to find the gap between short third man and backward point. It races away to the fence. IRELAND WIN BY 2 WICKETS!
Chance of a run out, MISSED! Fuller in length, on middle, Young flicks it straight to short fine leg and sets off for a run. He is sent back as Chase misses his shy at the striker's end.
Beaten again! A touch short around off, skidding off the surface, Young pushes inside the line and misses.
Another dot. Lands it on a length outside off, shaping away, Craig feels for it and gets beaten.
Big swing and a miss! Back of a length, around off, Young hangs back and tries to power it over the leg side but misses.
In the air, just out of the reach of the leg slip fielder. Turn and bounce, from around middle, Young tries to flick but it takes his gloves and flies wide of Odean Smith. A single is taken.
Very full and on middle, Adair knocks it down to long on for a run. 4 needed more.
Fullish and on middle, flicked to mid-wicket where Pollard made a tumbling stop.
Full and on off, Adair defends it back to the bowler.
Flighted and on middle, Mark gets back and works it to square leg.
Loopy and around off, Adair goes on the back foot and defends it to the off side.
Craig Young is the new man in.

OUT! Eight down! Is there a twist in the tale? Loopy and full around middle, Dockrell tries to defend the line but it spins away to gather the outside edge. Holder stretches to his right at first slip and takes a very good catch. Ireland showing inexperience.
Commentary.Howout: c Jason Holder b Akeal Hosein

Commentary.Commentary: Slower through the air, full and on off, Dockrell defends it off his front foot.
Mark Adair comes to the crease now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Reckless, another wicket falls. Floated and full around off, turning away, Delany skips down the track to heave it across the line but only manages a top edge. A simple catch for Shamarh Brooks at short third man. Went for the glory shot but it didn't bring glory. 5 needed more.
Commentary.Howout: c Shamarh Brooks b Akeal Hosein

Commentary.Commentary: Quicker and on middle, Dockrell turns it through square leg and hands the strike to Gareth Delany.
Lovely delivery, full and on off, turning away, George tries to defend the line but is beaten by the away spin.
Flighted and on off, defended off the front foot.
SIX! This one goes the distance. Ireland are now one big hit away from a historic moment. Loopy and full around off, Gareth Delany kneels and smokes it over wide long on for a biggie.
FOUR! Chase drags his length short, around off, Delany camps back and plays a full-blooded cut shot through cover-point. 200 up!
Flatter and on off, Delany defends it from the back foot.
Full and around off, defended off the front foot.

OUT! LBW! Floated one, full and around off, it lands and spins in, Tector attempts for the reverse-batted shot but fails to connect. He is pinged on the front pad, they appeal and the finger has gone up. Harry takes the DRS straightaway. No bat involved, confirms the UltraEdge and the Ball Tracking shows that the impact is in line and it's hitting the leg stump. The decision stays and ends Harry's stay. 16 needed more. Gareth Delany is the new batsman.

Review! Harry Tector has reviewed an LBW decision. The replay rolls in. UltraEdge confirms no bat involved. Ball Tracker shows three red lines! The on-field decision stands. Harry Tector has to walk back. Ireland lose a review as well.
Spinning in from around off, Harry defends it in front of his front pad.
Loopy and around off, landing full, GD leans forward and defends. 16 needed more.
Lunges to a full ball around off and defends it to the off side.
Floated and on middle, George moves back and helps it to square leg.
FOUR! Delicately played. Flatter and around off, spinning away, Dockrell stays inside the crease and guides it late past backward point for a boundary.
Gets forward to a full ball and drives it to point.
Tossed up around off, pushed to covers.
Powerplay 3 time. One extra fielder, i.e. 5 can now be put outside the 30-yard circle till the end of this chase. Kieron Pollard though would like to keep his field up and create a bit of panic.
Very full, outside off. George Dockrell eases it towards long off for a single. He retains the strike.
Quicker this time, around middle. Harry Tector clips it towards square leg for a single.
Flatter and on off, punched back past the bowler to long on for a single.
Gets on the back foot and helps it to mid-wicket.
George Dockrell arrives in the middle.

OUT! Bowled 'em! Floated one, around off, not short enough to attempt for the pull shot but Campher still tries to unveil it. The ball lands and turns back in to beat the bat of Curtis. It finds the stumps and Ireland lose their fifth wicket. 23 more to win from 64 balls.
Flatter ball, an off break, Tector pushes it towards long on for single.
Loopy ball, full and on middle. Curtis Campher defends it out.
FIFTY FOR Harry Tector! Fuller ball, outside off. Harry Tector drives it towards long off for a single. That's his third fifty of the series, he has been at his best on this tour!
FIVE WDES! Down the leg side. Tector misses his flick, Shai Hope fails to collect it as well. The ball races away for a boundary. Bonus runs for Ireland!
Fuller ball, around off, Tector leans to drive this but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Much flatter, on the pads. Harry Tector nudges it to mid-wicket. Another dot ball.
Another full ball, on off. Harry Tector blocks it out.
Loopy ball, full, outside off. Harry Tector drives it to the man at cover.
Bowling change. Akeal Hosein is back on.
FOUR! Cleverly done! Loopy ball, full and outside off, Curtis Campher gets low and sweeps this towards the right of the square leg fielder for a boundary.
Outside off, Curtis Campher dabs it to the fielder at point.
Quicker this time, on middle. Curtis Campher looks to flick this but gets an outside edge towards covers.
Fuller, spinning in, this one kept low. Curtis Campher tries to defend that but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Quicker, on the stumps. Harry Tector rocks back and works it away towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter, drifting it on the pads. Harry Tector flicks it to mid-wicket.
On a length, outside off. Harry Tector pushes it towards point for a single. Alzarri Joseph ends his spell with that ball.
Another short ball, around the thigh pad. Curtis Campher hops and tucks it away towards fine leg for a single.
Back of a length, outside the off pole. Curtis Campher, on the back foot, punches it towards deep cover for a brace.
Fuller ball, outside off. Curtis Campher blocks it towards covers.

FOUR! Lucky boundary. Back of a length, close to off, Campher tries to sway away but keeps his bat hanging out there. It takes the bottom edge and speeds past the keeper for a boundary at third man. Shai Hope was very late in realizing.
On a length, outside off. Harry Tector, hangs back and cuts it towards point for a single.
Firing it on the pads. Harry Tector nudges it towards square leg for a single.
Full again, around middle. Harry Tector blocks it off the front foot.
Quicker and just outside off. Harry Tector pushes it away towards point.
Curtis Campher is the new batsman. 45 needed off 87 balls.

OUT! TAKEN! Roston Chase strikes and Neil Rock departs early in the innings. A flatter ball, full and on middle, Neil Rock advances down the track and looks to take Chase on by lofting it over long on. He miscues his shot and Jason Holder runs across to his right from mid on to secure the catch. Is there a twist?
Commentary.Howout: c Jason Holder b Roston Chase

Commentary.Commentary: Quicker, shorter, on middle, Neil Rock cuts it towards cover. No run there.
Wide! Flatter ball, down the leg side. Neil Rock misses his flick. A wide given.
Flighted and on middle, helped to square leg for a single.
Sliding down the leg side, it's tucked to deep square leg for a single. 47 needed off 90 balls.
Back of a length, around off, Tector dabs it down to backward point.
Wide! Joseph sprays his bouncer down the leg side, Tector has nothing to do with it.
Short again, this time on middle, Rock swivels on the back leg and pulls it to fine leg for a run.
Beaten! Clever change in pace. Landing short and cutting away, Rock pokes inside the line and misses.
Around off on a length, played down from the crease to cover-point.
Short in length and outside off, Harry runs it down to third man for a run. 50 needed exactly.
Leans forward to a full ball and defends it back. Looking in no hurry.
Tossed up around middle, it's turned behind square leg for one.
Goes on the back foot and punches it with the spin, still finds mid-wicket.
Uses his wrists to work it on the leg side but finds the fielder inside the ring.
Drifting in around off, spinning into the batter too, Tector helps it off the inner edge to mid-wicket.
Loopy and full on off, Tector lunges and pushes it to point.
Slightly short in length, around off, Rock stays back-footed and taps it down to point.
Around middle, on a length, Rock tucks it on the leg side but finds mid-wicket.
Back of a length, close to leg, Neil attempts to glance but fails to connect.
Up and over, just short of the fielder. Short and outside off, Tector slams it over point and it falls in front of the fielder rushing forward from the deep. A single taken.
Odean responds with a bouncer around leg, Tector allows it through.
FOUR! No one in the deep on the off side and it's a boundary. Short in length and wide outside off, Harry rocks back and whacks it past the diving backward point fielder for a boundary.
Another drive from the bat of Neil Rock but he fails to pierce the gap at covers.
Quicker and full on off, pushed to point.
Full and flighted on off, Rock makes room and drives it to covers.
Presses forward to a full ball and knocks it down to long off for a single.
Loopy and full around off, it's driven past the bowler to long off for a single.
Flatter and on off, Harry goes back and punches it to long on for a run.
Roston Chase (3-0-16-0) is back on!
Back of a length, around off and angling away, Neil allows it through.
Wide! Short again, way wide outside off, Rock leaves and it's wided.
Neil Rock walks in to bat at number 5. He gets a promotion, perhaps to maintain the left-right combination. A slip is in place.

OUT! Edged and gone! Finally, West Indies have a breakthrough and the ploy of bowling short works. Short in length and wide outside off, McBrine hangs back to play the ramp shot but there is some extra bounce and it collects the outside edge. Shai Hope makes no mistake behind the stumps. Can West Indies capitalize on this breakthrough? 61 needed more off 115 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Shai Hope b Odean Smith

Commentary.Commentary: Digs in a short ball on middle, Andy McBrine ducks underneath it.
Misfield! Short and on middle, Harry pulls it through backward square leg and calls for two. Holder rushes across to his right in the deep, misfields and concedes the third run as well.
A touch short and on middle, defended off the back foot.
Slightly short and around leg, it's tucked behind square leg for a couple of runs.
Wide! Begins on a sorry note again. Sprays a length ball down the leg side, the batsman leaves and Hope does well to collect it.
Odean Smith is back into the attack. He bowled one over in Powerplay 1 and was all over the shop. Can he redeem himself?
Full, on off, Andy McBrine pushes it back to Akeal Hosein.
SIX! HAMMERED! A shorter ball, around middle, Andy McBrine swivels and pulls this over deep square leg for a six. Not a great ball to bowl at this time!
A quicker ball, around middle, Andy McBrine steps down the pitch and looks to heave this but gets an inside edge to the right of the keeper.
Quicker this time, around the pads. Andy McBrine tucks it towards square leg. No run taken.
Loopy ball, yorker length, around middle. Harry Tector jabs it towards deep cover for a single.
Akeal Hosein tosses this one up, on a full length, around middle. Andy McBrine drags it towards long on. One run taken.
Akeal Hosein is back on. 40/1 in his 6 overs so far.
On a length, around middle. Andy McBrine pushes it uppishly towards mid on for a single. He retains the strike. Ireland now 75 runs away.
Back of a length, around middle. Andy McBrine back away and tries to upper-cut it, but fails to get any bat on it.
Good-length delivery, on the pads. Harry Tector clips it towards fine leg. A single taken.
Change of angle for the right-hander. Alzarri Joseph goes from over the wicket, delivers a full ball, around middle and off. Harry Tector drives it to mid on.
On a length this time, outside off. Andy McBrine hangs back and cuts that towards deep point for a single.
Alzarri Joseph goes 'round the wicket, servers a short ball, outside off. Andy McBrine hops and blocks it towards point.

Drinks break. Ireland are comfortably placed in this chase at the moment. Another 78 runs required and they have plenty of overs and wickets in hand to do that. Andy McBrine did it with the ball and is now doing it with the bat as well. Since the departure of Paul Stirling, McBrine has taken things under his control and along with Harry Tector, he has stitched yet another handy stand to keep West Indies at bay.  The bowling from West Indies has been flat, to say the least and they seem to be going through the motions. Can they spark a comeback?
Firing it onto the stumps, on a full length. Harry Tector nudges it to mid-wicket.
FIFTY for Andy McBrine! Full ball, outside off. Andy McBrine drives it crisply towards long off for a single. It's been a calm and composed inning. An excellent half century.
Tosses it up this time, on middle. Andy McBrine pushes it back to the bowler.
Darting it on the leg side, quicker this time. Andy McBrine misses his flick.
FOUR! Edgy runs! A loopy ball, outside off and full in length. Andy McBrine hangs back, looks to cut it away but gets a bottom edge towards the third man fence for a boundary. He moves to 49 now.
Quicker and outside off. Andy McBrine pushes it to Kieron Pollard at extra cover.
Short, around off. Harry Tector covers the line and blocks it off the back foot.
Outside off, on a length. Andy McBrine steers it to third man for a single.
Short again, around the thigh pad. Harry Tector swivels and pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
Short in length, outside off. Harry Tector blocks it towards cover. No run taken.
Back of a length, outside off. Andy Balbirnie leans back and upper cuts that towards third man and rotates the strike.
Good running! Length ball, around middle and leg. Harry Tector flicks it past mid-wicket. The batters complete three runs.
The bouncer-bowling machine is back. Alzarri Joseph to speed in...
Flatter, and quicker, on middle. Harry Tector works it towards square leg for a single.
Loopy ball, outside off. Andy McBrine gets down and looks to sweep this but the ball hits his gloves and rolls towards fine leg for a single. That brings up the 50-run partnership between these two!
Quicker, outside off. Andy McBrine drives it to the man at cover. No run.
Loopy ball, full and on middle. Harry Tector taps it towards square leg for another single.
Quicker this time, on middle. Harry Tector tucks it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Roston Chase serves a full ball, outside off. Andy McBrine, on the back foot, cuts that towards sweeper cover for a single.
Width outside off, Tector flashes his bat hard at it but there is no connection.
That is punched off the back foot but straight to the fielder at point.
Short again and wide outside off, cut to deep point for one more single.
Reaches out to a short ball outside off and eases it to deep point for a run.

Shout for a caught behind! A gentle delivery, short and wide outside off, Harry tries to cut but it bounces over his bat. Pollard appeals but the umpire shakes his head. The bowler is lucky that it's not wided. Hello! There is some spike on the UltraEdge. West Indies chose not to review it.
Around off on a length, Harry defends it from the back foot to the off side.
Flatter delivery, it's fired in around off, Andy McBrine is forward in defense.
Quicker off spinner, turning away, McBrine mistimes his square cut towards covers.
All too easy. A gentle flick through mid-wicket for another run.
Drags his length short again, this time McBrine forces it to sweeper cover for a single.
Loopy and full on middle, Tector knocks it down to long on to rotate the strike.
FOUR! Poor delivery to start the spell. A half-tracker around off, turning in, Harry goes deep inside the crease and smacks it through point for a boundary.
Roston Chase comes into the attack now.
Shortish and on off, off pace, McBrine makes room and then tap it down to cover-point. A top over by the West Indian skipper.
Short and wide, McBrine cuts again but finds point.
Outside off, played down to point.
The length is short again, outside off, Andy cuts it towards backward point where Shamarh Brooks dives across to his right and parries it to short third man. Saves a certain boundary.
Short and wide outside off, slapped to sweeper cover for one. These two are just looking to tick it around.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and bunts it to long off for a single.
Slants it in around a length, Tector stays back and defends it down. 104 more needed.
Short and around leg, Andy swivels and pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Bouncer around off, Andy McBrine sways away from the line at the last moment.
Back of a length around leg, McBrine tries to make room for the pull shot but mistimes it towards mid on. The fielder there makes a tumbling half stop. No run taken.
Bouncer around leg, Andy McBrine sits underneath it.
A touch short on off, Harry uses the angle of the bowler and works it in the gap at mid-wicket for a single.
Bouncer on middle, at a gentle pace of 100 kph, Andy is in his zone, he ducks under it without any fuss.
Angling away from the left-hander, a fuller delivery and staying low, Andy McBrine tries to drive but misses.
Short and outside off, steered to deep point for one.
Outside off, tapped down to point.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and pushes it towards mid off for a run.
Fractionally short and on off, angling away, Andy McBrine punches it through extra cover and rushes back for the second run.
Bowling change. Kieron Pollard has decided to bring himself into the attack.
Romario Shepherd bangs it in short once again, down the leg side. Harry Tector ducks under it and lets that go through.
Another short ball, outside off. Andy McBrine cuts it towards point for a single.
WIDE! Short and down the leg side. Andy McBrine ducks underneath it. Wide given.

Direct hit would have been curtains for Andy McBrine! A short ball, around middle. Harry Tector tucks it towards square leg and takes off. Akeal Hosein collects the ball and has a shy at the keeper's end, but misses.
Another short ball, outside off. Harry Tector leaves it alone.
Back of a length, on the body. Andy McBrine pulls it towards fine leg for a single. That brings up the 100 for Ireland!
Good-length delivery, on middle, Andy McBrine defended it with the full face of his bat.
Romario Shepherd is back on. 0/18 in his 4 overs so far.
Shorter this time. Andy McBrine tucks it to square leg and takes a single. He retains the strike.
Quick single! Fuller, around middle. Harry Tector taps it towards mid-wicket and scampers through to the other end. Akeal Hosein chases the ball and has shy at the non-striker's end, but misses.
Fuller this time, tossing it up, outside off. Andy McBrine leans to drive but gets an inside edge towards mid-wicket. One run is taken.
Quicker, around off. Andy McBrine drives it towards cover. No run there.
Shorter and flatter. Harry Tector, on the back foot, tucks it towards mid-wicket and takes a run.
Beaten! Much better from Akeal Hosein! A full ball, outside off. Harry Tector hangs back and tries to push this away but gets beaten on the outside edge as the ball skids through the surface.
Alzarri Joseph drops it short this time, outside off. Andy McBrine bends and tries to go for the upper cut, but fails to get any bat on it. End of a very long over! Ireland need 118 runs more to win.
Wide outside off, on a length. Andy McBrine cuts it to the fielder at point.
A length ball, around middle. Andy McBrine shows the full face of his bat and defends it out.
Wide! Short and down the leg side, Andy ducks.
Around middle, on a length, Harry flicks it with lovely timing through square leg for a run.
Wide! Alzarri Joseph goes wide of the crease and delivers a length ball down the leg side, Harry tries to flick but misses.
A touch short and around off, holding its line, Harry pushes inside the line and misses.
Back of a length, around off and shooting off the surface, Tector is taken by surprise as he keeps it out from the shoulder of his bat to the off side.
Wide called for height! Alzarri Joseph digs it in short around middle, Tector has an easy leave.

DROPPED! Nothing going in the right direction for West Indies! This should have been caught. A full ball, on middle, Andy McBrine advances down the pitch and looks to go over long on but miscues his shot. The ball flies high, and Alzarri Joseph runs forward to take the catch from long on, but could not get hold of it cleanly, as he gets distracted by Odean Smith who was running for the catch as well from long off. This is dreadful fielding, no communication whatsoever. Two runs are taken.
Fires this on middle, a quicker ball. Andy McBrine nudges this towards mid-wicket. No run this time.
Fuller this time, on middle. Harry Tector forces it towards long off for a single.
Flat again, shorter and around middle, Andy McBrine tucks it towards mid on and rotates the strike.
Good running! Flatter and quicker on middle. Harry Tector taps it to cover and scampers through to the other end. Smart cricket here by Ireland!
FOUR! Beautiful shot! A loopy ball, full and on middle, Harry Tector gets down on his knee and sweeps this towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Another bouncer, around off. Andy McBrine once ducks and lets that go through.
Short, around middle and off. Andy McBrine ducks underneath it.
LEG BYE! Back of a length, down the leg side this time. Harry Tector looks to tap it towards the leg side. The ball deflects off his arm and rolls towards fine leg. The batters steal a leg bye.
Another short ball, around off. Harry Tector leans back and lets that go through to the keeper.
Alzarri Joseph drops it short, wide outside off, at 139 clicks. Harry Tector does not fiddle with that. He is overusing this short-ball tactic now and that takes away the surprise element.
Back of a length, outside off. Andy McBrine stands tall and punches this towards covers for a quick single. Good cricket by Andy McBrine!
Sensible. Goes back inside the crease to a shortish ball and nudges it to deep mid-wicket for a run. 133 needed more.
FOUR! Shot! Tossed up, full and around middle, Andy McBrine shimmies down the track and belts it over the bowler's head for a cracking boundary.
Arm ball this time, full and on middle, Tector tries to defend but it takes the inner edge and rolls to square leg for a run.
Beauty! Akeal Hosein has found his rhythm now. Lovely drift on this delivery, it lands on a fuller length around off and spins away, Harry pushes at it and misses.
Gets forward to a full ball and again drives it towards extra cover.
Loopy and full around off, Harry Tector drives it off his front foot to extra cover.
Bouncer again, on middle and leg, this time it's a comfortable duck for Andy. End of a hostile over from Joseph.
A well-directed bumper, around the right shoulder of the batter, Andy McBrine just about manages to evade it.
Fractionally short on off, leaving the batsman with the angle, McBrine pulls his bat back at the last moment.
Bouncer around middle, again Andy sits underneath it.
In the channel outside off, the batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Shortish and around off, Andy pushes inside the line and edges it towards short third man. The fielder there makes a tumbling stop.
Wide! A bumper on middle, well over the head of the batsman.

DRINKS! West Indies had a dream start, they picked up a wicket on the very first ball. But after that, Paul Stirling and Andy McBrine did well to rebuild and started scoring at a brisk rate. Akeal Hosein fought back to break the partnership after a successful review against Paul Stirling. Harry Tector is the new man at the crease. Also, Alzarri Joseph is back into the attack.

Shout for an lbw! Not given. West Indies have reviewed an LBW decision against Paul Stirling. The replay rolls in. Flat-line as the ball passes the bat, confirms UltraEdge. Ball Tracking though finds everything in line. The umpire changes his decision.

OUT! LBW! Akeal Hosein gives this one a good toss and lands it on a fuller length around middle and off. The ball hits the deck and spins away slightly to beat Stirling's attempt to work it around. He is hit on the back leg and a huge shout for an lbw follows. The umpire firmly shakes his head but Kieron Pollard decides to review it. UltraEdge finds no wood and the Ball Tracking shows that it's hitting him in line and going on to smash the stumps. End of a good knock from the Irish skipper and West Indies have an opening.
Uff...this beats the outside edge by a whisker. Akeal serves it full and around off, it lands and spins away to beat the forward defensive prod of Paul Stirling.
Quicker and flatter around off, Paul  defends it from the back foot.

FOUR! Tremendous! Beaten on the previous delivery and Stirling decides to use his feet. Advances down the track, stays leg side of the delivery and powers it over extra cover for a boundary. This partnership is running away with the show.
Beaten! Loopy and full around off, good drift on this delivery as it lands and spins away, Stirling tries to drive but misses.

FOUR! Deft! Tossed up around off, turning away a bit, Stirling stays put inside the crease and opens the face of his bat at the last moment to beat backward point. He moves on to 40 with this boundary.
FOUR! Holder delivers it full and in the zone for the batter, it's around off and angling in, McBrine opts for the aerial shot and clears the infield at mid off. A boundary results.
Play and a miss! Holder switches to 'round the wicket and serves it short and wide outside off, Andy flashes and misses. He is surprised that the umpire has not called it a wide.
Width on offer outside off, Stirling plays late and steers it past backward point for a single.
Once again the length is a touch short and around off, Stirling does well to tap it down to point.
Shortish and on off, defended from the back foot to the off side.

FOUR! Easy pickings! Back of a length, around middle and leg, Paul Stirling shuffles across the stumps and nudges it fine down the leg side for a boundary. Every run he scores will hurt Jason Holder as he was the one who dropped Paul on zero.
Quicker and fuller, around leg, Andy tries to sweep but misses. It brushes his pads and goes to the keeper. They appeal for a catch but nothing from the umpire.
Short and around off, Stirling uses the depth of his crease and steers it through cover-point for one.
Presses forward to a full ball and knocks it down to long off for a single.
Slightly short and on off, turning away, Paul goes back and cuts it through point for a single.
Loopy and full around leg, McBrine wrists it past the bowler to long on and jogs across to the other end.

Uppish but safe! Flighted and a touch short outside off, it sticks a bit on the pitch and then spins away, Stirling chases and plays it from the toe end of his bat. The ball goes wide of the cover fielder and they cross.
Powerplay 2 time. A maximum of 4 fielders are now allowed outside the ring till the 40th over - if this chase lasts till then.
A half-tracker, nipping back in. Andy McBrine looks to cut but gets an inside edge onto his pads. At the end of Powerplay 1, Ireland are 51/1, 162 needed more.
FOUR! Top shot! Much fuller this time, around middle and leg. Andy McBrine whips this past mid-wicket for a boundary.
Andy McBrine takes the aerial route this time, but is not in control of that shot. Touch fuller, outside off. Andy McBrine slices it over covers. Two runs are taken.
Back of a length, outside off, Andy McBrine shows the full face of his bat and blocks it out.
Short in length, outside of, a bit of extra bounce. Paul Stirling gets an outside edge towards third man for a single.
Jason Holder begins with a full ball, on middle, Paul Stirling defends it out watchfully.
Jason Holder is marking his run-up as he gets ready to bowl.
Short and flat, Andy McBrine stays back and pushes it back to the bowler.
WIDE! Akeal Hosein fires this down the leg side. Andy McBrine misses his flick. Wide given.
Flatter ball, around middle and leg. Paul Stirling taps it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Tad quicker, around middle, Andy McBrine cuts it through point and takes a run.
FOUR! Sweet shot! A fuller ball, on middle, Andy McBrine advances down the pitch and gently pushes it down the ground for a boundary.
Shorter, flatter, around off. Andy McBrine, on the back foot, pushes it towards cover-point. No run.
Akeal Hosein starts with a flatter ball, around middle, Paul Stirling nudges it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Akeal Hosein is into the attack now.
Short again, around leg, Andy McBrine ducks underneath it.
Back of a length, around middle, Paul Stirling taps it towards backward square leg for a single.
Length, on middle, Paul Stirling shuffles across and tucks it past mid-wicket for a brace.
FOUR! Gets hold of it this time! Short ball, wide outside off. Paul Stirling hangs back and slaps this over point for a boundary.
Swing and a miss! A shorter ball, around off. Paul Stirling steps down the pitch and looks to go over covers, but fails to get any connection.
On a length, nipping back in on the pads. Paul Stirling is late on his flick as he misses and gets hit on the thigh pad.
Short, on middle, Andy McBrine leans back and lets that go through. End of a long over, 11 runs off it.
WIDE! That's the fourth wide of the over. Odean Smith sprays this down the leg side. Shai Hope dives and does well to stop the ball.
Good-length delivery, on the pads. Andy McBrine misses his flick and gets rapped on the pad.
Much better this time! A length ball, close to the off pole. Andy McBrine looks to block that but gets an inside edge back to the keeper. Tighter line this time.
On a length, outside off. Paul Stirling covers the line and taps it towards point and rotates the strike.
WIDE! Not the best start for Odean Smith! Short, wide outside off again. Paul Stirling leaves it alone and wide is given.
Back of a length, outside off. Paul Stirling lets that go through.
SIX! Bang! That sounded so sweet as soon as it left the bat! Another short ball, outside off. Paul Stirling pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a biggie. First six for Ireland!
WIDE! Odean Smith drops it short again this time down the leg side. Paul Stirling leaves it alone. Wide called.
WIDE! Odean Smith begins with a short ball, wide outside off. Paul Stirling offers no shot.
Odean Smith is introduced into the attack, replacing Alzarri Joseph.
Fuller, swinging down the leg side. Andy McBrine tries to flick but misses and it goes off his pads to short fine leg. Just one run off that over.
On a length, outside off. Andy McBrine defends it towards cover.

A stifled shout for an LBW, but not given. This was on a length, nipping back in onto the pads. Andy McBrine tries to block this off the back foot, but he misses and gets hit on the front pad. Would have been the umpire's call, shows the Ball Tracking.
And again! Another short ball, outside off. Andy McBrine, on the back foot, goes to cut this on the off side but gets beaten again.
Beaten! Back of a length, outside off. Andy McBrine hops and looks to have a poke at it but gets beaten on the outside edge.
A length ball, around off, shaping away a tad. Paul Stirling looks to defend with soft hands but gets an outside edge towards deep point for a single.
Fuller and outside off, at 138 kph, McBrine tries to drive but fails to make any connection.
A 139 kph bouncer, around off, an easy leave for Andy McBrine.
Fuller around leg, at 145 kph, Andy tries to flick but fails to middle his shot. It rolls off his pads to the leg side.
A touch short and on off, Andy jumps on the back foot and defends it to the off side.
Bumper on middle at 140 clicks, McBrine ducks underneath it safely.
Short and on off, McBrine plays it down from the back foot to backward point.

Movement off the surface. Full and on off, Stirling presents a straight bat in defense but it nips back in to take a soft inside edge. It dribbles towards square leg and the batters collect a couple. 8 from the over!
Delivers it on a length and outside off, an easy leave on this occasion for the Irish skipper.
That's a good delivery. It's a good comeback from Shepherd. Bowls it on a length around off, nipping in, Stirling tries to defend but gets an inside edge onto the back pad.
In the channel outside off, on a length, Paul shuffles across the stumps and shoulders arms.

FOUR! Good calculative risk and it pays off. Stirling moves around inside the crease and puts off the bowler. Shepherd delivers it full and around leg, Paul whips it through square leg and beats the fielder near the fence.

Aerial but safe! Back of a length, around off and some extra bounce, Stirling tries to punch but it takes the outside edge and races down to third man. The fielder fumbles there and allows the second run.
Beaten all ends up! Full and outside off, skidding away with good pace, Andy McBrine tries to drive but is beaten comprehensively.
Slight halt in play. Andy McBrine has been struck on the helmet. A mandatory concussion check will be done, the physio is out there to do so. Checks are done, we are ready to resume!

Appeal for a catch, not given! It's off the helmet. Short in length and on middle, Andy McBrine tries to pull but it goes over his bat, pings him on the helmet and lobs up to the point fielder. Kieron Pollard decides not to review this decision. No bat, UltraEdge confirms.
Pitches it up and outside off, Andy throws his hands at it in an attempt to drive but it takes the inner edge and rolls towards mid on.
Wide! Sliding down the leg side, McBrine tries to flick but misses. Hope doesn't do a clean collection but no extra run is conceded.
Slightly off the edge. Extra bounce from a length around off, holding up a bit off the surface too, McBrine pushes at it gently and it goes off the outer half to point.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and pushes it to covers.
Wide! Hurls it wide outside off, Andy allows it through.

FOUR! Streaky! McBrine is up and running in a fortuitous fashion. Alzarri Joseph delivers it just behind a length around middle and gets it to move back in, McBrine is on his toes in an attempt to defend but it takes the inside edge and runs down to the fine leg fence.
Nice and straight, on a length around off, Paul presents a straight blade in defense.
That is defended solidly off the front foot.
Outside off, on a length, tapped down to point.

DROPPED! Jason Holder has put down the catch. A touch short in length, around off and moving away a hint, Stirling has a tame push inside the line and gets a thick outside edge to first slip. Jason Holder tries to catch it to his left but it bursts through his palms. The batsmen get a couple of runs and Paul is off the mark.
Romario pulls his length back a shade and delivers it on off, Paul goes on the back foot and defends it once again towards covers.
Full in length, around off and angling in, Stirling pushes it defensively to covers.
Romario Shepherd will bowl from the other end.
Fractionally short and on off, Andy stays on the back foot and plays it down to backward point. Top first over by Alzarri.
Serves it on a length around middle and off, McBrine gets squared up a bit as he defends it to the off side.
On a length and close to off, Andy pushes it from the back foot to covers.
Short again, in the channel outside off, McBrine drops his hands and allows it through at the last moment.
Back of a length, around off and angling away, Andy McBrine allows it through to the keeper.
Wide called for height! Joseph showing a lot of fire. Digs in a bouncer but it goes well over the head of the new batter.
Andy McBrine walks in at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT! What a start for West Indies! Short in length and wide outside off, Porterfield rocks back and tries to slam it over point but it takes a thick top edge and flies down to third man. Akeal Hosein settles near the fence and makes no mistake. West Indies are pumped up!
Commentary.Howout: c Akeal Hosein b Alzarri Joseph
